description: This file contains a shell script used for managing and testing git submodule updates, configurations, and various scenarios involving submodules. It includes functions for creating repositories, checking the state of submodules, and performing complex test workflows, particularly for ensuring correct behavior of submodule switching, updating, and conflict handling.

methods.name: create_lib_submodule_repo
methods.description: Initializes a set of git repositories with various submodule configurations for testing.

methods.name: replace_gitfile_with_git_dir
methods.description: Replaces a plain .git file with a full .git directory in a submodule.

methods.name: test_git_directory_is_unchanged
methods.description: Ensures the .git directory inside a submodule remains unchanged except for core.worktree.

methods.name: test_git_directory_exists
methods.description: Checks that a submodule's .git directory exists and is properly configured.

methods.name: prolog
methods.description: Sets up environment configurations and ensures repositories are initialized before tests.

methods.name: reset_work_tree_to
methods.description: Resets the working directory to a specified commit, updating submodules as necessary.

methods.name: reset_work_tree_to_interested
methods.description: Resets working directory to a specified commit and sets up submodule configs for testing.

methods.name: test_superproject_content
methods.description: Verifies that the superproject's working tree matches a specific commit.

methods.name: test_submodule_content
methods.description: Verifies that a submodule's content matches the expected commit.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch_common
methods.description: Performs common tests for switching submodule states, including addition, removal, and replacement scenarios.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch_func
methods.description: Runs a series of tests for switching submodule states using a specific command.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch
methods.description: Executes submodule switch tests with the standard git command.

methods.name: test_submodule_forced_switch
methods.description: Runs submodule switch tests allowing forced changes, disregarding local modifications.

methods.name: test_submodule_recursing_with_args_common
methods.description: Performs recursive submodule checkout tests with various transition scenarios.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch_recursing_with_args
methods.description: Runs recursive submodule switch tests with specific git command arguments.

methods.name: test_submodule_forced_switch_recursing_with_args
methods.description: Runs recursive submodule switch tests with forced updates and specific git command arguments.
